description: Orbitals of Stab(x) in Gamma = <Co_0 generators of data/group> on the Leech minimal vectors, as labels computed from explicit random stabiliser elements (labels refine the true orbitals; equality follows when the count equals the lower bound from data/scheme/triples.json). Orbital u = (i, o): pairs (y, z) with class(x, y) = i and z in orbit o of Stab(x, y) (moved to y_i). c[u][s][t] = #{w : (y, w) in s, (w, z) in t} for (y, z) in u.
orbitals_format: [id, i, o, z_rep, j = class(x,z), k = class(y_i,z), size = v_i * orbit_size, orbit_size, transpose_id, swap_xy_id]
